info.name: Social Inbox Automation API
info.description:
Postman collection for the NestJS backend (clients, business info, offers, services, users, auth, conversations, comments, n8n callback, n8n data and Meta webhooks).

## Getting started
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:3000`).
2. Run **Auth → Login** (set `userEmail` first). The token is saved to `accessToken` automatically.
3. Every other request inherits **Bearer {{accessToken}}** from the collection, except those marked *No Auth* (auth, n8n callback, n8n data, Meta webhooks).
4. Create requests save ids into `clientId`, `offerId`, `serviceId`, `resourceId` where applicable. Requests using `:id` use `{{resourceId}}`: copy the relevant id into it.

## Variables
| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | API root |
| `accessToken` | JWT (auto-filled on login) |
| `userEmail` | Email for login / user lookup |
| `appOrigin` | Origin header for `/auth/refresh` and `/auth/logout`; must equal server `APP_ORIGIN` |
| `clientId`, `offerId`, `serviceId`, `resourceId` | Resource ids |
| `postId`, `nextCursor` | Saved by **Clients → List Client Posts**: the first post's id and the next page's cursor |
| `runId` | Saved by **Inbox → Backfill Unanswered Comments**: the reply run's id |
| `n8nWebhookSecret` | Must equal server `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (n8n callback and n8n data) |
| `customerId` | A customer id (PSID / IGSID) for the conversation filters and the n8n data requests |
| `metaVerifyToken` | Must equal server webhook verify token |
| `metaAppSecret` | Meta app secret used to sign webhook payloads |
| `pageId`, `igAccountId` | Ids used in sample webhook payloads |

## Notes
- Request body schemas (Zod DTOs) were not provided, so example bodies are illustrative. Adjust them to your schemas.
- Roles: `PUT /clients/:id/access-token` and `POST /inbox/comments/backfill` enforce `ADMIN` via `RolesGuard`.

request.description:
Authenticates with `LocalGuard` (Passport local strategy). The controller returns `request.user` as-is.

**Auth:** none (credentials in body)

On success the response sets the httpOnly `fekra_session` cookie (used by *Refresh Session* and *Logout*) and returns `{ user, token }`. After 5 failed sign-ins for an email the account is blocked for 15 minutes; the response is the same `401` as a wrong password.

The test script tries to extract a token from the response (`accessToken`, `access_token` or `token`) and stores it in the `accessToken` collection variable, which is used as the Bearer token for every other request. If your login response uses a different field name, edit the test script on this request.

> **Note:** The exact body schema lives in the Zod schema referenced by the controller. The example body below is illustrative; adjust the fields to match your schema.

**Needs:** the cookie from *Login* (Postman keeps it in its cookie jar) and an `Origin` header equal to `APP_ORIGIN` (the `appOrigin` variable). Requests with another origin get `403`.

`401 SESSION_EXPIRED` after 30 minutes idle or 12 hours since sign-in.

Ends the session: the cookie is cleared and every access token issued for it stops working at once.

**Needs:** the `fekra_session` cookie and an `Origin` header equal to `APP_ORIGIN` (the `appOrigin` variable). Returns `204`.

request.description:
Creates a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

**Body:** `CreateClientDto`. `accessToken` is plaintext in and stored encrypted; it is never returned.

**Responses**
- `201` the client, `version: 1`. A `CREATED` activity entry is recorded.
- `409` `DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR` with `details.field` (`fbPageId` or `instaAccountId`) when that account already belongs to another client. Nothing is created.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR`: non-digit page id, logo over 255 characters, missing token, private-message replies on with no message.

> Use a placeholder token. Never put a real Meta token in this collection.

query.description: Matches business name or category, ignoring case (1-100 characters)
false = only the clients that are not subscribed to the chat service

request.description:
Lists clients.

**Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

**Query:** `QueryClientDto`: `page`, `limit`, `orderBy` (`name`, `businessCategory`, `createdAt`), `orderDir`, `search` (1 to 100 characters, matches name or category ignoring case; `%` and `_` are literal), and `chatSubscribed` (`true` or `false`; `false` lists the clients that still need to be subscribed to the chat service, the checklist after the release).

Each client has `chatWorkflowEndpoint` and `chatSubscribed`.
Fetches a client. Uses `{{resourceId}}` (set it to a client id, or copy from `clientId`).

Updates a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

**Body:** `UpdateClientDto`. `version` is required: send the version you loaded. Any other field is optional; only send what changed.

**`accessToken` is no longer accepted here** (422). Use *Set Client Access Token*.

**Responses**
- `200` the updated client with `version` + 1 and an `UPDATED` activity entry listing the changed field names. Identical values change nothing (version stays).
- `409` `CLIENT_VERSION_CONFLICT` when `version` is stale: `details` has `currentVersion`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy` (who saved last).

  ```json
  { "statusCode": 409, "errorCode": "CLIENT_VERSION_CONFLICT",
    "details": { "currentVersion": 4, "updatedAt": "2026-03-01T10:30:00.000Z", "updatedBy": { "id": "…", "name": "Sara" } } }
  ```
- `409` `DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR` with `details.field` when the account id belongs to another client.
- `404` unknown client, `422` invalid body or missing `version`.

**Chat service (feature 003).** `chatWorkflowEndpoint` is one path segment (`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$`) that is added to the fixed `N8N_BASE_URL`; `null` clears it. Several clients may use the same endpoint (one shared workflow, feature 004). `chatSubscribed` switches the chat service on or off. Only a subscribed client has its private messages handed to its workflow; the DMs of a client that is not subscribed are ignored and not stored.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.fieldErrors.chatWorkflowEndpoint` when the format is wrong, when you subscribe a client that has no endpoint, or when you clear the endpoint of a subscribed client (unsubscribe first).
- Unsubscribing keeps the endpoint. Both fields appear in the activity entry by name, never by value.

Permanently deletes a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

Its business info, services and offers are deleted with it; users linked to it are unlinked (`clientId` becomes null). A `DELETED` activity entry with the client's name is kept. A second delete returns `404`.

Replaces the client's access token (write-only). **Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

**Body:** `{ "token": string }`, 1 to 4096 characters after trimming. An empty token returns `422`; an unknown client `404`.

The response body is empty and the token is never returned by any endpoint. The client's `version` does **not** change. An `ACCESS_TOKEN_REPLACED` activity entry is recorded without the value.

> Use a placeholder token. Never put a real Meta token in this collection.

request.description:
Lists one page of a client's posts on Facebook or Instagram, newest first, read live from Meta (nothing is stored). **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

Uses `{{clientId}}` (the client's id, not a Facebook page id). The unreplied count of each post is a separate request: **Count Unreplied Comments**.

**Query:** `platform` (`facebook` or `instagram`, required), `limit` (1 to 25, default 25), `after` (the previous page's `meta.nextCursor`).

**Responses**
- `200` `{ data: ClientPost[], meta: { limit, nextCursor, fetchedAt } }`. `nextCursor` is `null` on the last page. Meta gives no totals, so this list does not use `page`/`totalPages`.
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` (no such client) or `ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED` (the client has no account on that platform, or Meta cannot find it with the client's token).
- `400` `BAD_REQUEST` (no access token on file), `META_TOKEN_INVALID` (expired or revoked: replace it with **Set Client Access Token**) or `META_PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR`: bad `platform`, `limit` or `after`, or a client id that is not a UUID.
- `502` `META_ERROR`, `503` `META_UNAVAILABLE` (Meta is down or rate-limiting; try again later). `details` carries Meta's `graphCode` / `graphSubcode`.

exec: pm.test('Returns the count and whether it is a minimum', () => {

request.description:
Counts the comments on one post that the account has not answered. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

Uses the same rule as a reply run, so the count equals the `pending` of **Backfill Unanswered Comments** started right after: a top-level comment that is not written by the account, is not hidden, has no reply from the account and, on Instagram, has text. A comment that only another customer replied to still counts.

Reads at most `COMMENT_BACKFILL_MAX` (500) comments. When the post has more, `truncated` is `true` and the count is a minimum.

Uses `{{clientId}}` and `{{postId}}` (saved by **List Client Posts**). On Facebook the post id must belong to the client's page (`{fbPageId}_…`).

**Query:** `platform` (`facebook` or `instagram`, required).

**Responses**
- `200` `{ postId, platform, checked, unrepliedCount, truncated, checkedAt }`.
- `404` `NOT_FOUND`, `ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED`, or `META_POST_NOT_FOUND` (deleted, or another account's post).
- `400` `BAD_REQUEST`, `META_TOKEN_INVALID` or `META_PERMISSION_DENIED`; `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR`; `502` `META_ERROR`; `503` `META_UNAVAILABLE`.

item.name: Business Info
item.description:
Business info attached to a client. Requires JWT. All routes are scoped by `clientId` (one record per client).

The controller has a TODO to move these under `/clients/:clientId/business-info`.

request.description:
Creates the business info of a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role. A client has at most one.

**Body:** `CreateBusinessInfoBodyDto`. Every field is optional. `clientId` is **not needed** in the body (the URL decides); when it is sent it must equal the one in the URL (`422` on `clientId` otherwise). The lists `socialMedia`, `paymentMethods` and `installmentOptions` default to empty.

Fields: `phone`, `whatsapp` (up to 50 characters), `email` (a valid address), `website` (an `http` or `https` address), `socialMedia` (list of `{ platform, url }`), `location` (`{ city, district, full_address, links }`), `workHours` (one entry per weekday, `sunday` to `saturday`, each `{ startTime, endTime }` as `HH:MM`; a day that is missing means closed), `paymentMethods`, `installmentOptions`. Unknown fields are rejected (`422`).

**Responses**
- `201` the business info.
- `409` `DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR` when the client already has business info (use **Update Business Info By Client**).
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` for an invalid field or a `clientId` that is not a UUID.

Fetches the business info of a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

**Responses**
- `200` the business info.
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` when the client has none yet. The dashboard then shows an empty form and a **Create** button. (This used to be an empty `200`.)
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` when `clientId` is not a UUID.

Updates the business info of a client. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role.

**Body:** a **partial** update (`UpdateBusinessInfoBodyDto`): a field that is not sent stays unchanged, and `null` clears a nullable field (`phone`, `email`, `whatsapp`, `website`, `location`, `workHours`). At least one field is required. `clientId` is optional in the body; when it is sent it must equal the one in the URL (`422` on `clientId` otherwise).

Fields: `phone`, `whatsapp` (up to 50 characters), `email` (a valid address), `website` (an `http` or `https` address), `socialMedia` (list of `{ platform, url }`), `location` (`{ city, district, full_address, links }`), `workHours` (one entry per weekday, `sunday` to `saturday`, each `{ startTime, endTime }` as `HH:MM`; a day that is missing means closed), `paymentMethods` and `installmentOptions` (lists without duplicates).

> Before feature 003 this request needed `clientId` in the body and reset every list that was not sent. It no longer does either.

**Responses**
- `200` the updated business info.
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` when the client has no business info yet (use **Create Business Info**).
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` for an invalid field, an empty body, a `clientId` that is not a UUID or that differs from the URL.
Deletes the business info of a client.

item.name: n8n Callback
item.description:
Server-to-server callback invoked by the n8n workflow after the AI reply is generated. **No JWT.** Authenticated by the `x-webhook-secret` header, which must equal the `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env var.

The server looks up the pending request by `id` (`N8nDeliveryService.take`). If the id is unknown/duplicate/expired the response is `{ acknowledged: false }`. Replies are sent asynchronously (fire-and-forget).

request.description:
Used when the pending request is of kind `batch` (direct messages). Only `id` and `text` are used. Empty/blank `text` sends nothing.

**Responses:** `200 {acknowledged:true}` | `200 {acknowledged:false}` (duplicate/expired) | `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` missing id or a `type` other than `engagement`/`question` (was `400` before feature 004) | `401` bad secret (checked first)

Extra keys are ignored, and `null` or `""` texts mean "not sent".

Used when the pending request is a comment. `type` must be `engagement` or `question` (defaults to `engagement`).

For `engagement`, typically `publicReply` is used.

body.raw:
{
  "id": "pending-request-id",
  "type": "question",
  "dmText": "Our opening hours are 8am-11pm daily.",
  "publicReplyIfDmSent": "Sent you a DM with the details!",
  "publicReplyIfDmClosed": "Please message us directly and we'll help right away."
}

request.description:
For `question` comments: send a DM and a public reply that depends on whether the DM could be delivered.

- `dmText`: private message text
- `publicReplyIfDmSent`: public reply if the DM was sent
- `publicReplyIfDmClosed`: public reply if the DM window is closed
Negative test: wrong secret returns 401.

item.name: n8n Data
item.description:
Data endpoints for the n8n chat workflows (feature 004): read a conversation's lead and history, and save the lead after every reply. n8n never touches the database directly.

**No JWT.** Every request carries the `x-webhook-secret` header, which must equal the server's `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (the `n8nWebhookSecret` variable here). A missing or wrong secret answers `401 UNAUTHORIZED` before the input is read.

Every request is scoped to one client: `accountId` must be that client's account on `platform` (`fbPageId` for `facebook`, `instaAccountId` for `instagram`), otherwise `404 CLIENT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`. Set `clientId`, `pageId` and `customerId` first.

query.description: The client's Page ID (or Instagram account ID)

request.description:
What the workflow knows about one customer on one client account, before it replies.

**Query:** `clientId` (uuid), `platform` (`facebook` or `instagram`, any case), `accountId` (the client's Page ID or Instagram account ID), `senderId` (the customer: PSID / IGSID), `historyLimit` (1-50, default 10).

**Responses**
- `200` `{ lead, history }`. `lead` is `null` when there is no lead yet. `history` is the last `historyLimit` exchanges of this client's conversation with the customer, **oldest first**, unanswered ones included (`answered: false`, `reply: ""`); `[]` when there is no conversation. Nothing is created.
- `401` `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or wrong `x-webhook-secret`.
- `404` `CLIENT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`: unknown client, or `accountId` is not its account on that platform.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.fieldErrors`.

body.raw:
{
  "clientId": "{{clientId}}",
  "platform": "facebook",
  "accountId": "{{pageId}}",
  "senderId": "{{customerId}}",
  "stage": "phone_captured",
  "phone": "01000000000",
  "country": "EG",
  "lastIntent": "pricing",
  "summary": "Clothes brand, asks for ad management pricing.",
  "fields": { "industry": "clothes", "page_link": "" },
  "claimNotification": true
}

request.description:
Saves what the workflow learned after a reply. Creates the lead or merges into it, in one transaction, keyed on (`platform`, `accountId`, `senderId`).

**Body** (unknown keys are refused): `clientId`, `platform`, `accountId`, `senderId`, `stage` (1-50, required), `phone` (max 30), `country` (2 letters, stored upper-case), `lastIntent` (max 50), `summary` (max 1000), `fields` (flat object of strings: at most 30 keys, keys max 50, values max 500), `claimNotification` (boolean, default `false`). `phone`, `country`, `lastIntent` and `summary` may be `null` or `""`.

**Merge rules**
- `fields`: shallow merge. A non-empty value overwrites; an empty string never erases a stored value (and is not stored).
- `phone`, `country`, `lastIntent`, `summary`: `null`, a missing key or `""` keep the stored value.
- `stage`: always the sent value.
- `claimNotification: true` sets `notifiedAt` only if it is still empty. `notifiedNow` is `true` only for the request that set it, even when several arrive at once: notify the client only then.

**Responses**
- `200` `{ lead, notifiedNow }`.
- `401` `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or wrong `x-webhook-secret` (checked before the body).
- `404` `CLIENT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`: unknown client, or `accountId` is not its account on that platform. Nothing is saved.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.fieldErrors`. Nothing is saved.
Negative test: a wrong secret returns 401 before the body is read.

item.name: Inbox
item.description: Inbox operations. Requires JWT with the `ADMIN` role (`RolesGuard`).

exec: pm.test('Returns the pending count and the run to follow', () => {

request.description:
Starts a **reply run** on a post: replies to the comments the page never answered (replaces the Telegram "reply to old comments" n8n workflow). **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

Fetches the post's top-level comments, keeps the ones that are not from the page, not hidden and have no reply from the page, then feeds them newest first into the inbox, one every `COMMENT_BACKFILL_DELAY_MS` (default 5000). Just before each one, the run checks that it was not stopped, that the client still has comment replies on, and that the comment still needs a reply (not answered, hidden or deleted since the run started). Each one then goes through the normal comment flow: classifier, Gemini if unsure, then reply / DM / like / hide.

The run is recorded in the activity record (`REPLY_RUN_STARTED`) and can be followed with **Get Backfill Run** and stopped with **Stop Backfill Run**. Only one run per post can be in progress.

**Body:** `{ "accountId": string, "postId": string }`
- `accountId`: Facebook Page ID or Instagram account ID. The platform is taken from the client that owns it.
- `postId`: Facebook post ID (`{pageId}_{postId}`) or Instagram media ID. `{{postId}}` is saved by **Clients → List Client Posts**; use the same Facebook page as `{{pageId}}`.

**Responses:**
- `202` `{ platform, postId, total, pending, delaySeconds, run }`: the run continues in the background. `run` is the run to follow (saved to `{{runId}}`), or `null` when `pending` is `0`: nothing starts and nothing is recorded.
- `404` no client owns `accountId`.
- `400` `BAD_REQUEST` the client has no access token.
- `409` `COMMENT_REPLIES_DISABLED` the client's comment replies are turned off (nothing would be posted).
- `409` `CONFLICT` a run is already in progress for this post; `details.runId` is that run.
- Meta errors (`details` has Meta's `graphCode` / `graphSubcode`):
  - `404 META_POST_NOT_FOUND`: the post isn't on this page or the token can't see it. Use the `post_id` from a comment webhook.
  - `400 META_TOKEN_INVALID`: the client's token is expired or revoked.
  - `400 META_PERMISSION_DENIED`: the token is missing a permission.
  - `503 META_UNAVAILABLE`: Meta is down; try again later.
  - `502 META_ERROR`: any other Meta rejection.

exec: pm.test('Has a state and the handled counter', () => {

request.description:
Reads a reply run's progress or outcome. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

Uses `{{runId}}` (saved by **Backfill Unanswered Comments**). The dashboard polls this every 5 seconds while `state` is `running`.

**Response `200`:** `{ id, clientId, accountId, platform, postId, state, interruptReason, total, toAnswer, handled, queued, dropped, skipped, delaySeconds, startedAt, estimatedEndAt, endedAt, startedBy, stoppedBy }`
- `state`: `running`, `finished`, `stopped` or `interrupted`. An ended run stays readable for 24 hours (`COMMENT_BACKFILL_RESULT_TTL_SEC`).
- `handled = queued + dropped + skipped`, out of `toAnswer`. `queued`: accepted by the inbox. `dropped`: refused by the inbox (a duplicate or a blocked sender). `skipped`: answered, hidden or deleted since the run started, or the re-check failed.
- `interruptReason` (when `interrupted`): `SERVER_RESTART` (the server died mid-run: reported once the run's lock expires, about a minute after the last comment), `COMMENT_REPLIES_DISABLED`, `ACCOUNT_DISCONNECTED` (the client was deleted or lost the account) or `META_ACCESS_LOST` (Meta rejected the client's token).

**Other responses:** `404` `BACKFILL_RUN_NOT_FOUND` (unknown id, or ended more than 24 hours ago); `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` (the id is not a UUID).

Stops a running reply run. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise). Any admin can stop any run.

Uses `{{runId}}` (saved by **Backfill Unanswered Comments**). No further comment is started; the one being handled, if any, is completed. The post is free for a new run right away, and comments not reached stay unreplied. A stopped run cannot be resumed: start a new one, which picks up what is still unreplied. The stop is recorded in the activity record (`REPLY_RUN_STOPPED`).

**Responses**
- `200` the run, now `state: stopped`, with `stoppedBy` and the number `handled` so far.
- `404` `BACKFILL_RUN_NOT_FOUND` (unknown id, or ended more than 24 hours ago).
- `409` `BACKFILL_RUN_ENDED` the run had already ended; `details.state` is its final state (`finished`, `stopped` or `interrupted`). Nothing changes.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` the id is not a UUID.

item.name: Conversations
item.description:
Customer conversations (private messages) and the assistant pause.

Reading needs a JWT with the `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role (a CLIENT user only sees their own client, others answer `404`). Pause and resume are `ADMIN` only.

exec: pm.test('Is a paginated list with the new fields', () => {

query.description: Only paused conversations (false = only active ones)

request.description:
Lists conversations, most recent activity first. **Requires:** `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role. A `CLIENT` user is always scoped to their own client; `clientId` only applies to `ADMIN`.

**Query:** `page`, `limit` (1-100), `orderBy` (`updatedAt`, `createdAt`), `orderDir`, `clientId` (ADMIN), `platform` (`facebook` or `instagram`), `senderId` (the customer identifier, **exact match** after trimming: the dashboard search box), `receiverId`, `paused` (`true` = only conversations whose assistant is paused now, `false` = only active ones).

**Each item** has `clientName`, `paused`, `pausedAt`, `pausedUntil`, `pausedBy` (`{ id, name }` for `ADMIN`, always `null` for `CLIENT`) and `lastExchange` (`{ message, reply, answered, createdAt }`, each text cut to 200 characters, `null` when there is no exchange yet).

A timed pause that has ended is not paused: `paused` is `false` and the pause fields are `null`.

Saves `{{chatId}}` from the first item.

One conversation, for the thread header. **Requires:** `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role.

**Responses**
- `200` the conversation (same shape as an item of **List Chats**).
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` for an unknown id, and for another client's conversation when the caller is a `CLIENT` user (nothing shows whether it exists).
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` when the id is not a UUID.

exec: pm.test('Every exchange says whether the assistant answered', () => {

query.description: desc = newest first, asc = from the top

request.description:
The exchanges of one conversation. **Requires:** `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role (a `CLIENT` user only reaches their own client's conversations: `404` otherwise).

Newest first by default: send `orderDir=asc` to read the conversation from the top. The dashboard reads the newest 20 and loads earlier ones on request.

Each item has `message` (messages answered together are joined with a line break), `reply`, `answered` and `createdAt`. A message received while the assistant was paused has `answered: false` and an empty `reply`.

Pauses the assistant in one conversation. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

**Body:** `{ "duration": "until_resumed" | "1h" | "24h" | "7d" }`.

While the conversation is paused the assistant sends no automatic reply, and a reply that is being prepared when the pause takes effect is not sent. New customer messages are still stored, marked `answered: false`. Other conversations are not affected. A timed pause ends by itself; the end is recorded as an automatic resume.

Pausing an already paused conversation replaces its duration. Every pause is recorded with who did it, when and the duration.

**Responses**
- `200` the conversation with `paused: true`, `pausedAt`, `pausedUntil` (`null` = until resumed) and `pausedBy`.
- `403` `FORBIDDEN` for a `CLIENT` user (nothing changes).
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` unknown conversation.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR` for a duration that is not one of the four.

Resumes the assistant in one conversation. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

The assistant answers the customer's **next** message. Messages that arrived during the pause stay marked `answered: false` and are not answered afterwards.

On a conversation that is not paused now (also a timed pause that already ended) this changes nothing and records nothing: it answers `200` with the conversation.

**Responses**
- `200` the conversation with `paused: false`.
- `403` `FORBIDDEN` for a `CLIENT` user.
- `404` `NOT_FOUND` unknown conversation.

item.name: Comments
item.description:
Classified comments: the list, and the CSV download for checking the classifier later.

Reading needs a JWT with the `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role (a CLIENT user only sees their own client). The download is `ADMIN` only.

exec: pm.test('Each comment says how it was decided', () => {

query.description: How the label was decided (rules, ai_model, safe_fallback, unknown)

request.description:
Lists every comment the platform classified, newest first. **Requires:** `ADMIN` or `CLIENT` role (a `CLIENT` user is scoped to their own client; `clientId` only applies to `ADMIN`).

**Query:** `page`, `limit`, `orderDir`, `clientId`, `platform`, `classification` (`engagement`, `inquiry`, `unsure`, `complaint`, `spam`, `insult`), `decisionBasis` (`rules`, `ai_model`, `safe_fallback`, `unknown`), `from`, `to` (a `to` before `from` is `422` on `to`). Enum values are case-insensitive.

**Each item** has `clientName`, `decisionBasis` (`RULES`, `AI_MODEL`, `SAFE_FALLBACK`, `UNKNOWN`) and `decisionModel` (the model name for `AI_MODEL`). Comments from before the basis was recorded are `UNKNOWN`. A comment labelled `SPAM` with basis `SAFE_FALLBACK` was **not** judged to be spam: the AI model failed and spam is the safe default.

Comments of clients with comment automation turned off are not classified, so they are not in this list.

exec: pm.test('Is a CSV download with no caching', () => {
pm.test('Starts with the byte order mark and the header row', () => {

request.description:
Downloads every comment that matches the filters as a CSV file, with **no row limit**. **Requires:** `ADMIN` role (403 otherwise).

**Query:** the filters of **List Classified Comments** (`clientId`, `platform`, `classification`, `decisionBasis`, `from`, `to`). No `page`, `limit` or order (422).

**The file:** UTF-8 with a byte order mark (Excel shows Arabic correctly), a header row, CRLF line ends, columns `id, clientId, clientName, platform, commentId, comment, classification, decisionBasis, decisionModel, reason, createdAt`. A cell that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return gets a leading apostrophe, so a spreadsheet never runs customer text as a formula. It is streamed in pages, so any size works. Comments created after the request started are not in it, so the row count equals the list `meta.total` at that moment.

If the download fails halfway the connection is closed early, so the client sees a failed download and not a short file that looks complete.

Every download is recorded (who, when, the filters, the number of rows, whether it completed). The record holds no comment text.

**Responses**
- `200` `text/csv; charset=utf-8`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="comments-<date>-<time>.csv"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- `403` `FORBIDDEN` for a `CLIENT` user.
- `422` `INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR`, for example `to` before `from`.

item.name: Meta Webhooks
item.description:
Webhook endpoint for Meta (Facebook Pages + Instagram). **No JWT.**

- `GET` is the subscription verification handshake.
- `POST` receives events and is verified via `x-hub-signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256 of the **raw body** with the app secret). The requests below compute the signature automatically in a pre-request script using the `metaAppSecret` variable.

Events are processed asynchronously; the endpoint always answers `200 {received:true}` once the signature is valid.

query.description: Must match the server's verify token

request.description: Meta's verification challenge. Returns `hub.challenge` as plain text if `hub.verify_token` matches the server's configured token.
Simulates a Facebook Page event (`object: page`) routed to `MetaWebhookService.handleEvent`. Example: an incoming Messenger message.
Simulates a Facebook Page feed comment event (`object: page`, `changes` with `field: feed`).
Simulates an Instagram event (`object: instagram`) routed to `InstagramWebhookService.handleEvent`.
Simulates an Instagram comment event (`changes` with `field: comments`).
Negative test: sends a wrong signature. The exact status depends on `MetaWebhookService.verifySignature` (typically 401/403).
